description: Na₃TmSi₂O₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TmO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TmO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one TmO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 76°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.58 Å) and three longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TmO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TmO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one TmO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 76°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.47 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.51 Å) and three longer (2.53 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.28 Å. There are three inequivalent Tm sites. In the first Tm site, Tm is bonded to six O atoms to form TmO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.22 Å) and three longer (2.23 Å) Tm-O bond lengths. In the second Tm site, Tm is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TmO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Tm-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. In the third Tm site, Tm is bonded to six O atoms to form TmO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.22 Å) and three longer (2.24 Å) Tm-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two TmO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TmO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-36°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two TmO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TmO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-37°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.69 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Tm, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Tm, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Tm, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂TmSi tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Tm, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Tm, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Tm, and one Si atom.
